canonical_statement: The individual soul originates from the divine source.

attributions.surface_quote: I came from you.

canonical_statement: The divine source functions as the essential mind of the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: You are my mind.

canonical_statement: The divine source is the ontological fullness and rest of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: You are my fullness: accept me. You are my rest.

canonical_statement: The divine exists prior to the manifestation of the temporal world.

attributions.surface_quote: you who exist and preexisted

canonical_statement: Human consciousness can transcend sensory and cognitive limitations to perceive divine mysteries.

attributions.surface_quote: Grant what eyes of angels have not seen, what ears of rulers have not heard.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary vessel that obscures the true nature of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is a temporary vessel obscuring the soul.

canonical_statement: The material world is a state of ignorance or illusion that prevents the recognition of divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is a state of ignorance preventing divine recognition.

canonical_statement: Liberation is achieved through the acquisition of secret knowledge regarding one's spiritual essence.

attributions.surface_quote: Liberation is achieved through secret knowledge of spiritual essence.

canonical_statement: The kingdom of heaven is an internal state of fullness achieved through knowledge rather than external command.

attributions.surface_quote: no one will ever enter the kingdom of heaven because I ordered it, but rather because you yourselves are filled.

canonical_statement: The human soul is distinct from the spirit, and the spirit serves as the animating force for the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: Be filled with spirit but lack in reason, for reason is of the soul. It is soul.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a destructive force that kills the soul unless both the soul and spirit are purified.

attributions.surface_quote: The spirit animates the soul but the body kills it. The soul kills itself.

canonical_statement: Existence in the material world is transient and illusory compared to the eternal life of the spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: If you consider how long the world has existed... you will see that your life is but a day.

canonical_statement: True identity is found by transcending the material self and recognizing one's origin in the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: I say this to you that you may know yourselves.

canonical_statement: The divine realm is accessible through the intentional elevation of consciousness and spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: We knelt down... and sent our hearts up to heaven.

canonical_statement: The totality of existence originates from the Father, who is the source of all emanations.

attributions.surface_quote: The totality is in the Father, from whom all things come forth.

canonical_statement: Ignorance of the Father manifests as a state of terror and confusion, creating a phantom-like reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Ignorance of the Father brought about terror and confusion.

canonical_statement: The manifestation of the Son serves to reveal the Father and dissolve the illusion of ignorance.

attributions.surface_quote: The Son appeared to reveal the Father and end the terror of ignorance.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is fundamentally rooted in the Father, and returning to this source constitutes the restoration of the self.

attributions.surface_quote: Each one will know himself, returning to the Father from whom he came.

canonical_statement: The Father is an illimitable, inconceivable, and perfect unity from whom all existence emanates.

attributions.surface_quote: all was inside of him, that illimitable, inconceivable one

canonical_statement: Ignorance of the Father is the root cause of error, fear, and the illusion of separate existence.

attributions.surface_quote: This ignorance of the father brought about terror and fear.

canonical_statement: The material world is a deficient, illusory substitute for truth, lacking a root in the Father.

attributions.surface_quote: Since error had no root, she was in a fog regarding the father.

canonical_statement: Knowledge (Gnosis) is the mechanism by which forgetfulness is destroyed and the soul returns to the Father.

attributions.surface_quote: knowledge, which was revealed so that forgetfulness might be destroyed

canonical_statement: The Son is the revealed name and manifestation of the Father, acting as the bridge between the fullness and the deficient.

attributions.surface_quote: The name of the father is the son.

canonical_statement: Individual souls are emanations of the Father that must return to their source to achieve perfection.

attributions.surface_quote: it is necessary for all to ascend to him

canonical_statement: The state of ignorance is akin to a dream or sleep; awakening to knowledge reveals the unreality of the material condition.

attributions.surface_quote: as if they were fast asleep and found themselves a prey to troubled dreams.

canonical_statement: The Father's will is the foundational cause of all things, even those not yet manifest.

attributions.surface_quote: Nothing happens without him, nor does anything occur without the will of the father.

canonical_statement: The resurrection is not a future event but a present realization of the spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: Do not think the resurrection is an illusion. It is not, but it is truth.

canonical_statement: The soul possesses an inherent immortality that transcends the death of the physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: You have risen. You have died and risen again.

canonical_statement: The material world is a temporary state, while the spiritual reality is the true, enduring existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is a passing thing, but the spirit is eternal.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is maintained through the transition from physical existence to spiritual realization.

attributions.surface_quote: You are the one who has risen, and you remain yourself.

canonical_statement: The human condition is a synthesis of humanity and divinity, designed to reconcile the finite world with the infinite pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: He embraced both qualities, possessing humanity and divinity so he could... restore the pleroma.

canonical_statement: The material world is an illusory, transient state, while the resurrection is the revelation of an eternal, unchanging truth.

attributions.surface_quote: It is more proper to say that the world is illusion, rather than the resurrection.

canonical_statement: Resurrection is not a future event but an immediate, internal realization of one's imperishable nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Flee from being scattered... and then you already have resurrection.

canonical_statement: The soul's origin is a pre-existent, eternal realm; the current life is a temporary descent into corruption.

attributions.surface_quote: At the beginning he was above as a seed of truth, which was before the cosmos.

canonical_statement: True salvation involves the shedding of the perishable material body and the preservation of the living, spiritual essence.

attributions.surface_quote: The visible parts of the body that are dead will not be saved.

canonical_statement: The Father is the unbegotten, immutable, and singular root of all existence, existing prior to any other being.

attributions.surface_quote: He existed before anything other than himself came into being.

canonical_statement: The Father is incomprehensible and transcends all human conceptual categories, names, and sensory perception.

attributions.surface_quote: It is impossible for mind to conceive him, nor can any speech convey him.

canonical_statement: The Son and the Church exist eternally as emanations of the Father, sharing in his nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Not only did the Son exist from the beginning, but the Church, too, existed from the beginning.

canonical_statement: The aeons are emanations of the Father's thought, initially existing as potential seeds before achieving individual consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: They only had existence in the manner of a seed... they did not exist for themselves.

canonical_statement: The Logos's attempt to comprehend the incomprehensible Father resulted in a defect, manifesting as division, ignorance, and the creation of a material world.

attributions.surface_quote: He looked into the depth and he doubted. Out of this there was a division.

canonical_statement: The material world is a system of shadows, copies, and likenesses of the spiritual Pleroma, lacking inherent reality.

attributions.surface_quote: They are their likenesses, copies, shadows, and phantasms, lacking reason and the light.

canonical_statement: The Savior is the knowledge of the Father, acting as a bridge to restore the defective aeons to unity.

attributions.surface_quote: The Son... is the knowledge of the Father, whom he wanted them to know.

canonical_statement: The universe is organized into hierarchical ranks of powers, archons, and spirits, reflecting the degree of their proximity to or distance from the Pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: The whole establishment of matter is divided into three.

canonical_statement: Material reality is a shadow-like projection of higher powers, serving as an educational environment for the development of consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: visible creations are like a shadow cast from and following a body

canonical_statement: Humanity is a composite being formed from spiritual, psychic, and material substances, reflecting the influence of multiple cosmic orders.

attributions.surface_quote: The first human being is a mixed formation, a deposit of those of the left and right.

canonical_statement: Ignorance of the Totality is equivalent to death, while eternal life is defined as the attainment of firm knowledge of the Totalities.

attributions.surface_quote: that which is dead is ignorance; life eternal is firm knowledge of the Totalities.

canonical_statement: The experience of evil and death is a providential mechanism designed to facilitate the eventual transition to higher states of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: It was a work of providence that man should experience the great evil, which is death.

canonical_statement: The spiritual substance is unified, whereas material and psychic substances are characterized by fragmentation and multiple forms of inclination.

attributions.surface_quote: The spiritual substance is a single thing; its weakness is the determination in many forms.

canonical_statement: Humanity is divided into three essential types—spiritual, psychic, and material—based on their origin and disposition.

attributions.surface_quote: Mankind came to be in three essential types, the spiritual, the psychic, and the material.

canonical_statement: The ultimate goal of existence is the restoration of all things to a unitary state within the Pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: The end will receive a unitary existence, just as the beginning is unitary.

canonical_statement: Redemption is the process of returning to the pre-existent, ineffable state of unity through knowledge of the truth.

attributions.surface_quote: The freedom is the knowledge of the truth which existed before the ignorance was ruling.

canonical_statement: The Savior, as an image of the unitary Totality, underwent incarnation to provide a path for the restoration of all beings.

attributions.surface_quote: The Savior was an image of the unitary one, he who is the Totality in bodily form.

canonical_statement: The material race is inherently dark and destined for destruction, as it resists the light of the unitary truth.

attributions.surface_quote: The material race, however, is alien in every way; since it is dark, it shuns the shining of the light.

canonical_statement: The psychic race occupies an intermediate position, possessing the potential for both good and evil through faith and instruction.

attributions.surface_quote: The psychic race, since it is in the middle when it is brought forth and also when it is created, is double.

canonical_statement: The Father is fundamentally unknowable and incomprehensible, yet manifests himself to allow for the salvation of the Totality.

attributions.surface_quote: His Father is one, and alone is truly a father to him, the invisible, unknowable, the incomprehensible.

canonical_statement: The material world is a flawed imitation created by an ignorant demiurge.

attributions.surface_quote: The ruler created a world in ignorance.

canonical_statement: Humanity possesses a divine spiritual essence that transcends the physical realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The spiritual man is more powerful than the rulers.

canonical_statement: The physical body acts as a prison or limitation for the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul is trapped within the material form.

canonical_statement: The material universe is a flawed projection originating from a shadow cast by the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: A veil exists between the world above and the realms below, and shadow came into being.

canonical_statement: The creator of the material world is an ignorant, arrogant entity unaware of the higher divine reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Their chief is blind. Because of his power and his ignorance he said, 'I am god.'

canonical_statement: Human identity is dualistic, consisting of a material/psychic component modeled by lower rulers and a spiritual component originating from the incorruptible light.

attributions.surface_quote: The spirit came forth from the adamantine land. It descended and came to dwell in him.

canonical_statement: The material world and its rulers are inherently powerless against those who possess the spirit of truth.

attributions.surface_quote: None of them can prevail against the root of truth.

canonical_statement: Death is a construct of the lower authorities and can be transcended through the realization of one's divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: All who have known this way exist deathless in the midst of dying people.

canonical_statement: The material world is a secondary manifestation derived from a higher, primordial spiritual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: The world originated from a higher, primordial spiritual reality.

canonical_statement: The physical universe is characterized by limitation and imperfection compared to the infinite nature of the source.

attributions.surface_quote: The material world is limited and imperfect.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness possesses an inherent connection to the divine, despite its current state of material entrapment.

attributions.surface_quote: Human consciousness is connected to the divine.

canonical_statement: Chaos is not the primordial state, but a secondary product derived from a preceding shadow.

attributions.surface_quote: chaos comes from a shadow... it existed before chaos came into being

canonical_statement: The material world and its rulers are products of a defect or error in the divine emanation process.

attributions.surface_quote: Pistis saw what had resulted from her defect

canonical_statement: The demiurgic ruler is characterized by ignorance of his own origin and the existence of higher divine realms.

attributions.surface_quote: the ruler Yaltabaoth, he is ignorant of the force of Pistis

canonical_statement: Humanity is composed of three distinct types: the spirit-endowed, the soul-endowed, and the earthly.

attributions.surface_quote: the spirit-endowed of eternity, and the soul-endowed, and the earthly

canonical_statement: The physical body serves as a prison or enclosure for the light of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: their modelled form became an enclosure of the light

canonical_statement: Knowledge (gnosis) acts as a catalyst that awakens the intellect and reveals the illusory nature of the material rulers.

attributions.surface_quote: when they had eaten, the light of knowledge had shone upon them

canonical_statement: The material world is governed by fate, which limits the lifespan and experience of embodied beings.

attributions.surface_quote: fate, which had been fixed since the beginning

canonical_statement: The process of spiritual initiation or purification occurs in a tripartite structure.

attributions.surface_quote: there are three baptisms

canonical_statement: The material world is governed by inferior rulers who maintain control through ignorance and distraction.

attributions.surface_quote: the rulers were master over it - that is, they kept it restrained by ignorance.

canonical_statement: Humanity is composed of multiple distinct races, with the 'kingless' race being the highest and most perfect.

attributions.surface_quote: the fourth race is kingless and perfect, being the highest of all.

canonical_statement: The ultimate destiny of an individual is determined by their origin, acts, and knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: everyone must go to the place from which he has come.

canonical_statement: The material universe is a temporary construct destined for dissolution and return to the unbegotten light.

attributions.surface_quote: the light will withdraw up to its root. And the glory of the unbegotten will appear.

canonical_statement: The appearance of enlightened beings in the material world serves to condemn the rulers and reveal hidden truth.

attributions.surface_quote: they reveal the pattern of imperishability as a condemnation of the rulers.

canonical_statement: The soul originates from a higher, divine realm and is cast into the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul came from the upper world and was cast into the body.

canonical_statement: The material body acts as a prison or a place of suffering for the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is a place of suffering for the soul.

canonical_statement: The soul possesses a dual nature, capable of both divine recollection and worldly corruption.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul is double, having both divine and earthly aspects.

canonical_statement: Salvation is achieved through the soul's recognition of its divine origin and subsequent return.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul must recognize its origin to return to the light.

canonical_statement: The soul is inherently feminine in nature and possesses a womb.

attributions.surface_quote: Sages gave the soul a feminine name. In nature she is also feminine.

canonical_statement: The soul originated in an androgynous state of unity with the Father before descending into a physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: While she was alone with her father, she was a virgin and in an androgynous form.

canonical_statement: The material world and the physical body are domains of deception that defile the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The domain of the flesh and the perceptible realm... by which the soul is defiled.

canonical_statement: The soul's womb is naturally oriented outward toward the material world but can be turned inward through repentance.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul's womb is turned to the outside... when the womb... turns itself inward, she is baptized.

canonical_statement: Salvation is the process of the soul's regeneration and return to its original state through divine grace.

attributions.surface_quote: It is right that the soul be regenerated and be as she formerly was.

canonical_statement: True spiritual marriage involves the soul reuniting with its divine counterpart to become a single life.

attributions.surface_quote: In this marriage once they join they become a single life.

canonical_statement: The material world is a transient illusion that obscures the true, eternal nature of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The visible world is a deception that hides the truth.

canonical_statement: Self-knowledge is the primary mechanism for recognizing one's divine origin and escaping the cycle of ignorance.

attributions.surface_quote: He who knows himself knows the All.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary vessel or prison for the spirit, which originates from a higher, non-material realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is a fire that consumes the spirit.

canonical_statement: Self-knowledge is the prerequisite for understanding the totality of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: he who has known himself has at the same time already achieved knowledge about the depth

canonical_statement: The physical body is a perishable, bestial formation that decays and lacks inherent life.

attributions.surface_quote: that which changes will decay and perish, and has no hope of life

canonical_statement: Visible reality is an illusion sustained by the fire of bodily lust and passion.

attributions.surface_quote: the fire that blazes in the bodies of men... will give them an illusion of truth

canonical_statement: Souls that remain attached to the material world are subject to repeated reincarnation and suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: the vessel of their flesh will dissolve... they will be gathered back to that which is visible

canonical_statement: The ultimate goal of the soul is to escape the cycle of bodily existence and achieve rest in the Pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: come forth from the bondage of the bitterness of this life... you will receive rest

canonical_statement: The kingdom of the divine is not a physical location but an internal state of awareness.

attributions.surface_quote: The kingdom is inside you and it is outside you.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is a construct that obscures the pre-existing unity of the self.

attributions.surface_quote: When you make the two one, you will become the son of man.

canonical_statement: The material world is a derivative manifestation of a primary, non-material light.

attributions.surface_quote: If you are asked where you come from, say, 'We have come from the light.'

canonical_statement: The kingdom of God is an internal state of being rather than a geographic location.

attributions.surface_quote: the kingdom is inside you and it is outside you.

canonical_statement: Self-knowledge is the prerequisite for recognizing one's divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: When you know yourselves, then you will be known.

canonical_statement: The material world is a transient, illusory state that will eventually pass away.

attributions.surface_quote: This heaven will pass away and the one above it will pass away.

canonical_statement: The ultimate spiritual goal is the unification of dualities into a single, whole state.

attributions.surface_quote: When you make the two into one... then you will enter the kingdom.

canonical_statement: The divine presence is immanent and pervasive within all material objects.

attributions.surface_quote: Split a piece of wood. I am there. Lift up the stone and you will find me.

canonical_statement: The soul is fundamentally distinct from the body and should not depend upon it.

attributions.surface_quote: How miserable is the body that depends on a body, and how miserable is the soul.

canonical_statement: The kingdom of heaven is currently present and manifest, but remains invisible to those lacking perception.

attributions.surface_quote: The father's kingdom is spread out upon the earth and people do not see it.

canonical_statement: Truth is not presented in a naked form but through symbols and images.

attributions.surface_quote: Truth did not come into the world naked, but it came in types and images.

canonical_statement: The soul must undergo a transformation or rebirth to perceive the divine reality.

attributions.surface_quote: One must be born again to enter the kingdom.

canonical_statement: The material world is a reflection or shadow of a higher, spiritual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: The world came into being through a mistake.

canonical_statement: The material world and the eternal realm are inseparable, causing worldly dualities like life and death to lose their absolute nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Light and darkness, life and death... are siblings of one another, and inseparable.

canonical_statement: Human language in the world is deceptive because it designates worldly objects rather than the eternal realities the words represent.

attributions.surface_quote: The names of worldly things are utterly deceptive, for they turn the heart from what is real.

canonical_statement: The soul is a precious entity currently residing within a worthless physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: It is something precious, and it has come to be in a worthless body.

canonical_statement: In the realm of truth, perception is transformative; to see a thing is to become that thing.

attributions.surface_quote: People cannot see anything that really is without becoming like it.

canonical_statement: The material world originated from a mistake by its creator, rendering it and its creator corruptible.

attributions.surface_quote: The world came into being through a mistake.

canonical_statement: Resurrection is a state of being that must be attained while still alive in the body, rather than an event occurring after death.

attributions.surface_quote: If they do not receive the resurrection first, while they are alive, they will receive nothing.

canonical_statement: Evil is a root that remains powerful only as long as it is hidden; recognizing and bringing it to light destroys it.

attributions.surface_quote: As long as the root of evil is hidden, it is strong. When it is recognized, it is undone.

canonical_statement: Truth does not exist in the world in a manifest form, but is represented through symbols and images.

attributions.surface_quote: Truth did not come into the world naked, but in symbols and images.

canonical_statement: The soul undergoes a process of transformation or rebirth through the acquisition of spiritual knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: One must be reborn to enter the kingdom.

canonical_statement: The material world is a construct that obscures the perception of the underlying spiritual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is a deception that hides the truth.

canonical_statement: The material world and the eternal realm are distinct, with the former being a temporary, illusory reflection of the latter.

attributions.surface_quote: The names of earthly things are illusory. We stray from the real to the unreal.

canonical_statement: True identity is found by becoming the object of one's perception, whereas in the world, the observer remains separate from the observed.

attributions.surface_quote: In the other truth you are what you see.

canonical_statement: The soul's liberation requires the internal recognition and uprooting of the source of evil, which otherwise masters the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: Dig down after the root of evil that is within us and pluck it out.

canonical_statement: Ignorance is the fundamental cause of death and non-existence, while knowledge of truth confers freedom and eternal life.

attributions.surface_quote: Ignorance is the mother of all evil. Ignorance will eventuate in death.

canonical_statement: The physical body is an image or garment that must be transcended or transformed through spiritual mystery to inherit the eternal realm.

attributions.surface_quote: Flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of god.

canonical_statement: The world was created through error and is inherently impermanent, whereas the eternal realm is characterized by fullness and stability.

attributions.surface_quote: The world came into being through error.

canonical_statement: The union of male and female principles in the 'bridal chamber' represents the restoration of original wholeness and the overcoming of death.

attributions.surface_quote: When the image and angel are joined, none can force themselves on the man and woman.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an unbegotten, self-existent principle that precedes all temporal and spatial manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: He is unbegotten, having no beginning and no end.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is inherently unknowable and transcends all linguistic or conceptual categorization.

attributions.surface_quote: No name can be named for him.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is hierarchical, emanating from a singular, primordial source into multiple levels of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: He is the father of all, existing before all things.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine principle is unbegotten, beginningless, nameless, and transcends all human-like form or definition.

attributions.surface_quote: He-Who-Is is ineffable... He has no name; for whoever has a name is the creation.

canonical_statement: Entities originating from the imperishable realm possess an inherent, immutable nature that cannot perish.

attributions.surface_quote: Whatever came from imperishableness will not perish but will become imperishable.

canonical_statement: The material world and its temporal structures are lower-order reflections or types of higher, spiritual aeonic realities.

attributions.surface_quote: Our aeon came to be as the type of Immortal Man. Time came to be.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured through a hierarchical emanative process where thoughts and powers manifest as distinct aeons.

attributions.surface_quote: From thoughts, reflectings; from reflectings, considerings; from considerings, rationalities.

canonical_statement: The ultimate divine reality is self-reflective, perceiving itself within itself as a mirror.

attributions.surface_quote: He sees himself within himself, like a mirror, having appeared in his likeness.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an unbegotten, infinite, and incomprehensible spirit existing beyond all temporal and spatial categories.

attributions.surface_quote: The Imperishable One is unbegotten, and there is no one who begot him.

canonical_statement: The manifest universe is a series of emanations originating from a singular, transcendent source.

attributions.surface_quote: He is the beginning of all things, and he is the end of all things.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is a reflection or extension of the divine, capable of returning to its source through knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: He who knows the truth knows the place from which he came.

canonical_statement: Time and material existence are secondary, illusory constructs compared to the eternal nature of the spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: He is not in time, for he was not created.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an ineffable, unbegotten, and nameless principle that transcends all created forms and authorities.

attributions.surface_quote: He Who Is is ineffable. No principle knew him... he has no name.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured by emanations from the Infinite Light, descending from perfection into lower, defective states.

attributions.surface_quote: Everything that came from the perishable will perish... whatever came from imperishableness does not perish.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness contains a divine spark or 'drop' of light that is currently trapped in a state of forgetfulness within the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: All who come into the world, like a drop from the Light, are sent... by the bond of his forgetfulness.

canonical_statement: The material world and its governing authorities are products of ignorance and arrogance, distinct from the true, transcendent God.

attributions.surface_quote: I came... because of the arrogance of Arch-Begetter and his angels, since they say... they are gods.

canonical_statement: Salvation is achieved through the acquisition of gnosis, which allows the soul to transcend material forgetfulness and return to the source.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoever, then, knows the Father in pure knowledge will depart to the Father.

canonical_statement: The primordial reality is androgynous, reflecting a union of male and female principles that generate all subsequent aeons.

attributions.surface_quote: Immortal Androgynous Man... and his consort is the Great Sophia.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary, corruptible vessel distinct from the eternal, incorruptible intellectual essence.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is a perishable vessel for the incorruptible spirit.

canonical_statement: Sensory perception of the material world is an illusion that obscures the true, transcendent reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Those who see with physical eyes are blind to the true light.

canonical_statement: The material universe is a construct governed by lower powers, separate from the ultimate divine source.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is ruled by powers that do not know the true God.

canonical_statement: The human soul is not universally immortal; only those of an immortal substance possess true existence.

attributions.surface_quote: not every soul is of the truth, nor of immortality.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary, replaceable substitute for the true, incorporeal, intellectual spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: the body is the substitute... what they released was my incorporeal body.

canonical_statement: Reality is divided into two distinct ontological categories: the immortal Pleroma and the transient, illusory creation.

attributions.surface_quote: that which is always becoming is in that from which it is... that which comes to be in the Eternal One.

canonical_statement: Perception of truth is dependent on the nature of the observer; the uninitiated are ontologically blind.

attributions.surface_quote: these (people) are blind and deaf.

canonical_statement: The material world and its structures are governed by entities that lack true perception and are destined for dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: all that which exists not will dissolve into what exists not.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary, illusory vessel that obscures the true, eternal nature of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: the body is a temporary vessel

canonical_statement: True knowledge of the divine is achieved through the transcendence of material perception.

attributions.surface_quote: transcendence of material perception

canonical_statement: The material world is a construct of limitation that separates the individual from their primordial origin.

attributions.surface_quote: material world is a construct of limitation

canonical_statement: The material world and its governing powers originated from a deficiency caused by the mother's unauthorized attempt to create eternal realms.

attributions.surface_quote: The disobedience and the foolishness of the mother... wanted to set up eternal realms.

canonical_statement: Mortal bodies are artificial constructs created by lower powers as a misrepresentation of true forms.

attributions.surface_quote: He assigned the powers within his authority to mold mortal bodies.

canonical_statement: The divine savior enters the mortal realm to restore the fallen seed to the fullness of the father.

attributions.surface_quote: I was sent down in the body for the seed that had fallen away.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is currently detained in a mortal dwelling place because it belongs to the divine fullness.

attributions.surface_quote: Concerning the fact that you are being detained, it is because you are mine.

canonical_statement: The inner person is the primary site of conflict between the divine spirit and the lower governing powers.

attributions.surface_quote: The rulers fight against the inner person.

canonical_statement: Suffering is an inherent condition of existence within the fallen mortal realm.

attributions.surface_quote: We are the ones who have suffered through the mother's transgression.

canonical_statement: The material world is a place of suffering and deception that obscures the true nature of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The city is full of great poverty and suffering.

canonical_statement: True identity is found by transcending the physical form and the limitations of the worldly city.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the one who has come from the light.

canonical_statement: The divine realm is hidden from those who remain attached to material wealth and sensory perception.

attributions.surface_quote: You cannot enter the city if you carry the burden of gold.

canonical_statement: The path to the divine realm requires the total renunciation of worldly attachments and material desires.

attributions.surface_quote: No man is able to go on that road, except one who has forsaken everything.

canonical_statement: The divine presence can adopt multiple, shifting forms to interact with humanity while remaining hidden from the proud.

attributions.surface_quote: Lithargoel, having changed, came out to us. We did not recognize him.

canonical_statement: True spiritual healing addresses the heart, with physical healing serving as a sign to validate the healer's authority.

attributions.surface_quote: The physicians of souls, however, heal the heart.

canonical_statement: The material world is a place of trial and endurance, where the kingdom of heaven is inhabited through perseverance.

attributions.surface_quote: By everyone who endures his trials, cities are inhabited, and a precious kingdom comes.

canonical_statement: Divine wisdom and the name of the Savior possess a value that transcends all material wealth.

attributions.surface_quote: My name, which you teach, surpasses all riches.

canonical_statement: The material world is a realm of temporary limitation and suffering distinct from the divine fullness.

attributions.surface_quote: This world is a place of suffering and temporary existence.

canonical_statement: Human identity is fundamentally rooted in a divine origin that transcends the physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: You are not of this world, but come from the fullness.

canonical_statement: Knowledge (gnosis) of one's true nature is the mechanism for liberation from the cycle of material entrapment.

attributions.surface_quote: Know yourself and you shall be free from the archons.

canonical_statement: The physical body and the sensory world act as obstacles or veils preventing the realization of the spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is a prison that hides the light of the spirit.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an unnameable, ineffable, and pre-existent source from which all existence derives.

attributions.surface_quote: Nothing existed except Him-who-is. He is unnameable and ineffable.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is a construct of the material world; true identity is realized by transcending the physical body and returning to the pre-existent source.

attributions.surface_quote: You will reach Him-who-is. And you will no longer be James; rather you are the One-who-is.

canonical_statement: The material world and its governing powers (archons) are subordinate to a higher, non-material order.

attributions.surface_quote: These are the seventy-two heavens, which are their subordinates.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary, restrictive state that obscures the soul's true nature and origin.

attributions.surface_quote: cast away from your blind thought, this bond of flesh which encircles you.

canonical_statement: The soul's return to its origin requires specific knowledge of its divine lineage to bypass the detainers of the lower realms.

attributions.surface_quote: Who are you or where are you from? You are to say to him, 'I am a son, and I am from the Father.'

canonical_statement: The material world is characterized by forgetfulness and ignorance, which can be overcome through the recollection of one's divine origin.

attributions.surface_quote: You have come with knowledge, that you might rebuke their forgetfulness.

canonical_statement: The material world is a realm of temporary illusion and suffering that obscures the true divine origin of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: This world is a place of suffering and temporary existence.

canonical_statement: True knowledge of the self is equivalent to the recognition of one's divine nature and origin.

attributions.surface_quote: Know yourself and you shall know the Father.

canonical_statement: The physical body acts as a prison or limitation for the eternal spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: The body is a garment that binds the spirit.

canonical_statement: The material world and its creator are inferior, temporary, and distinct from the eternal Pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: His labor, which is far from the aeons, is nothing.

canonical_statement: Human beings are imprisoned in physical forms fashioned by a demiurgic power to resemble itself.

attributions.surface_quote: After he imprisoned those from the Father, he seized them and fashioned them to resemble himself.

canonical_statement: Liberation from the material condition is achieved through gnosis (knowledge) rather than moral judgment.

attributions.surface_quote: It is by knowledge that I shall come forth from the flesh.

canonical_statement: The true self is an eternal entity that existed before incarnation and returns to its original state upon stripping away the flesh.

attributions.surface_quote: You are also the first who will strip himself, and you shall become as you were before.

canonical_statement: The creator of the material world is not the ultimate Father, but a subordinate entity who falsely claims sole authority.

attributions.surface_quote: Your father is not my father. But my father has become a father to you.

canonical_statement: The physical body and its actions are not the true essence of the individual, but are controlled by external forces.

attributions.surface_quote: It is not you that did them, but it is your Lord that did them.

canonical_statement: The soul undergoes a process of ascent through celestial realms after death.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul ascends through the heavens to reach the place of rest.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is subject to judgment by celestial entities based on earthly conduct.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul is examined by toll collectors at the gates of the heavens.

canonical_statement: The material world is a lower, restricted domain compared to the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul leaves the lower world to return to its original divine home.

canonical_statement: The material world is a realm of death, and human bodies are entities revealed to a soul-seed by higher powers.

attributions.surface_quote: the one that reveals bodies to a soul-seed

canonical_statement: Visible reality contains hidden metaphysical structures that can be perceived through awakened consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: know the hidden things in those that are visible

canonical_statement: The soul's post-mortem journey involves passing through hierarchical celestial realms governed by gatekeepers and toll-collectors.

attributions.surface_quote: angels bringing a soul out of the land of the dead

canonical_statement: Individual identity is subject to judgment based on past actions, with witnesses testifying to sins committed in the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: the three witnesses came... I charge you with the murders you committed

canonical_statement: Reincarnation is a process where souls are cast down from celestial judgment into prepared physical bodies.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul that had been cast down went to a body which had been prepared

canonical_statement: Access to higher celestial realms requires specific signs or spiritual credentials to bypass the authority of lower archons.

attributions.surface_quote: Give him the sign that you have, and he will open for you

canonical_statement: The true origin of the soul is a transcendent realm beyond the material creation and its governing authorities.

attributions.surface_quote: I am going to the place from which I came

canonical_statement: The primordial human consciousness originated from a divine source distinct from the creator of the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: We came from the great eternal realms, not from the creator of this world.

canonical_statement: The material world is a construct of limited, inferior powers that seek to obscure the true divine origin of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: The powers of this world seek to hide the knowledge of our eternal origin.

canonical_statement: True identity is found through the recollection of a pre-existent state of being prior to the fall into materiality.

attributions.surface_quote: Remember the light that was in you before the world was made.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness originates from an eternal, non-material realm, distinct from the creator of the physical world.

attributions.surface_quote: Eve and I didn't come from this realm.

canonical_statement: The physical body and the material world are under the authority of death and are inherently separate from eternal life.

attributions.surface_quote: The whole creation that came from the dead earth will be under the authority of death.

canonical_statement: True knowledge of the eternal god is an internal, incorruptible essence that transcends the physical senses and the creator-god's powers.

attributions.surface_quote: Those who reflect on the knowledge of the eternal god in their hearts will not perish.

canonical_statement: The material world is governed by powers that demand fear and slavery, contrasting with the freedom of the eternal realm.

attributions.surface_quote: We served him in fear and slavery.

canonical_statement: The soul's origin determines its destiny; those originating from eternal angels are not subject to the corruption of the material creator.

attributions.surface_quote: Their souls did not come from a defiled hand, but from an eternal angel's great command.

canonical_statement: The 'Illuminator' is a trans-historical entity that periodically enters the material realm to liberate souls from the authority of the creator-powers.

attributions.surface_quote: The illuminator of knowledge passes by in great glory to leave some of the seed.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is characterized by the simultaneous existence of contradictory attributes.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the whore and the holy one.

canonical_statement: The divine consciousness is both the creator and the created, existing in all states of being.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the one who is hated everywhere and who has been loved everywhere.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is a manifestation of a singular, universal consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the knowledge of my inquiry and the finding of those who seek me.

canonical_statement: The nature of existence transcends conventional temporal and spatial limitations.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the first and the last.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a paradoxical unity that encompasses all contradictory states and binary opposites simultaneously.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the first and the last... the whore and holy... the mother and daughter.

canonical_statement: The external world is a reflection or projection of the internal state of the observer.

attributions.surface_quote: What is in you is outside, and one who fashions you on the outside shapes you inside.

canonical_statement: The divine source is both the origin of existence and the ultimate destination of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: There they will find me and live, and they will not die again.

canonical_statement: The nature of the divine is incomprehensible and transcends human linguistic categories.

attributions.surface_quote: I am a silence incomprehensible and an idea remembered often.

canonical_statement: The relationship between the divine and the individual is characterized by a reciprocal, shifting proximity.

attributions.surface_quote: On the day I am close to you, you are far, and on the day I am far, I am close.

canonical_statement: The divine realm exists as an incorruptible, eternal substrate beyond the reach of material authorities.

attributions.surface_quote: The incorruptible realm exists above the authorities of chaos.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness possesses an inherent, uncreated spark that originates from the transcendent source.

attributions.surface_quote: The spark of light within the human soul is uncreated.

canonical_statement: The material world is a construct of inferior, ignorant powers rather than the ultimate reality.

attributions.surface_quote: The world was fashioned by powers who do not know the true God.

canonical_statement: The individual soul possesses a pre-existent divine mind that predates the creation of the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: possessing that which she had received before the world came into being.

canonical_statement: The Pleroma is a state of fullness and completeness, contrasted with the state of deficiency.

attributions.surface_quote: she will behold the Pleroma, and she will not be in deficiency

canonical_statement: The divine essence is immanent within all human manifestations of the primordial Adam.

attributions.surface_quote: He it is who is within all of the Adams

canonical_statement: The ultimate goal of the soul is to achieve self-generation and union with the Imperishable Ones.

attributions.surface_quote: she (too) might generate herself... and that she might be joined to all of the Imperishable Ones

canonical_statement: The human mind is a reflection of the divine intellect and possesses the capacity to return to its source.

attributions.surface_quote: The mind is the dwelling place of God.

canonical_statement: Ignorance functions as a state of spiritual darkness that obscures the true nature of the self.

attributions.surface_quote: Ignorance is the mother of all evils.

canonical_statement: The soul undergoes a process of purification to transcend material attachments.

attributions.surface_quote: Cleanse your heart from the filth of the world.

canonical_statement: Time and material existence are transient conditions compared to the eternal nature of the spirit.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is a passing shadow.

canonical_statement: The human soul is composed of three distinct substances: an earthly body, a formed soul, and a divine mind.

attributions.surface_quote: You have come into being from three races: from the earth, from the formed, and from the created.

canonical_statement: The mind is a non-local entity that exists in the body by being but transcends place through thought.

attributions.surface_quote: The mind, with respect to actual being, is in a place... but with respect to thought, the mind is not in a place.

canonical_statement: God is simultaneously omnipresent in power and transcendent of all location in divinity.

attributions.surface_quote: With respect to power, to be sure, he is in every place; but with respect to divinity, he is in no place.

canonical_statement: The material world is a deceptive copy of a hidden, spiritual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Everything which is visible is a copy of that which is hidden.

canonical_statement: Self-knowledge is the necessary prerequisite for understanding the nature of God and the spiritual hierarchy.

attributions.surface_quote: If you do not know yourself, you will not be able to know all of these.

canonical_statement: Christ functions as the bridge between the human and the divine, acting as the image through which the Father is known.

attributions.surface_quote: You cannot know God through anyone except Christ, who has the image of the Father.

canonical_statement: The soul's state is determined by its alignment with either the animal/fleshly nature or the rational/divine nature.

attributions.surface_quote: You will take on the likeness of the part toward which you will turn yourself.

canonical_statement: The soul is a distinct entity that originates from a realm beyond the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul comes from a place of truth.

canonical_statement: The material world is a construct of ignorance or deception that obscures true reality.

attributions.surface_quote: The world is a place of error and ignorance.

canonical_statement: True knowledge of the divine is achieved through the rejection of worldly attachments.

attributions.surface_quote: One must abandon the world to know the truth.

canonical_statement: True knowledge of the self is identical to knowledge of the divine All.

attributions.surface_quote: This is the perfect life, that man know himself by means of the All.

canonical_statement: The material world and carnal procreation are under the governance of archons and are antithetical to the light.

attributions.surface_quote: The dominion of carnal procreation had come to an end.

canonical_statement: Salvation is achieved through the renunciation of the material world and the acquisition of spiritual knowledge, not through ritual or legalistic adherence.

attributions.surface_quote: The baptism of truth is something else; it is by renunciation of the world.

canonical_statement: The human soul is currently bound by ignorance and the influence of lower powers, requiring a process of self-liberation.

attributions.surface_quote: They came to know themselves... and what is the place in which they will rest.

canonical_statement: The physical body and its sensory pleasures are a form of defilement that obscures the truth.

attributions.surface_quote: The Jordan river is the power of the body, that is, the senses of pleasures.

canonical_statement: The true spiritual essence of a person exists independently of the corruptible flesh.

attributions.surface_quote: Do not expect, therefore, the carnal resurrection, which is destruction.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is immutable and remains unaffected by the material world or human suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: I was not afflicted in any way, nor did I suffer.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary, illusory vessel distinct from the true, incorporeal self.

attributions.surface_quote: I did not die in reality but in appearance.

canonical_statement: The material realm is a construct of ignorance, separate from the true spiritual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: They were in error, not knowing who I am.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness is fundamentally unified with the divine source, existing as a singular, non-dual reality.

attributions.surface_quote: I am in you and you are in me.

canonical_statement: The material world and its physical bodies are constructed by lower, ignorant powers using inferior elements.

attributions.surface_quote: She took materials from the elements below to build bodily dwellings.

canonical_statement: The death of the enlightened being in the physical realm is an illusion; the true self remains untouched by physical suffering.

attributions.surface_quote: I did not die in reality but in appearance.

canonical_statement: The historical figures and religious authorities of the world are counterfeit imitations, ignorant of the true divine nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Adam and Abraham and Isaac and Jacob were a laughingstock.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of existence is a return to a state of undivided, perfect union within the divine pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: They will be perfected in the third glory.

canonical_statement: The physical body is a temporary, deceptive vessel that obscures the true, imperishable nature of the soul.

attributions.surface_quote: You do not know this because the fleshly cloud overshadows you.

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of two opposing principles, light and darkness, which are fundamentally distinct and unmixed.

attributions.surface_quote: The light and the darkness are two separate powers.

canonical_statement: The material world is a product of the interaction or conflict between primordial forces.

attributions.surface_quote: The world came into being through the conflict of light and darkness.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness possesses a spark of the divine light that is currently trapped within the material darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: The light is held captive within the darkness of the world.

canonical_statement: The universe originated from three distinct roots: light, darkness, and a spirit existing between them.

attributions.surface_quote: There was light and darkness, and there was spirit between them.

canonical_statement: The material world and human nature are products of the interaction between light and the chaotic, ignorant darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: Nature was divided into four parts... chaotic fires.

canonical_statement: The human soul is a burden to the darkness and originates from a source distinct from the material world.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul is a burden to the darkness.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is a particle of light trapped within the body and nature, requiring remembrance to return to its source.

attributions.surface_quote: Through remembrance he will be able to grasp them.

canonical_statement: Physical existence and material rituals, such as baptism, are forms of bondage that perpetuate ignorance.

attributions.surface_quote: They are deceived by manifold demons, thinking that through baptism... the water will take away sins.

canonical_statement: The material universe is destined for destruction, at which point the light will be separated from the darkness.

attributions.surface_quote: In the last day the forms of nature will be destroyed.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a singular, undivided, and transcendent essence that precedes all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: the first aeon, the self-begotten, the self-generated

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is hierarchical, manifesting through successive emanations from the primary source.

attributions.surface_quote: the three steles of Seth, the living ones

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness can achieve union with the divine through intellectual and spiritual ascent.

attributions.surface_quote: you have known yourselves, that you are from above

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a singular, unborn, non-being spirit that precedes all existence and knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: You are spirit, alone and living. There is nothing active prior to you.

canonical_statement: The divine emanates through a process of division and replication while remaining essentially unified.

attributions.surface_quote: You have been divided everywhere, you have remained one.

canonical_statement: Salvation is achieved through the acquisition of knowledge of the divine and the act of glorification.

attributions.surface_quote: Knowledge of you is our salvation.

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is hierarchical, consisting of emanations that act as shadows of the preceding level.

attributions.surface_quote: We are a shadow of you, as you are a shadow of that first preexistent one.

canonical_statement: The process of spiritual ascent and descent through levels of reality is identical in structure.

attributions.surface_quote: The way of ascent is the way of descent.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is derived from and dependent upon the divine mind.

attributions.surface_quote: I am your son and you are my mind, O my father.

canonical_statement: The attainment of divine knowledge facilitates a transition from a mortal state to a divine, immortal state.

attributions.surface_quote: You have received the eighth, which reveals the ninth.

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is hierarchical, consisting of distinct levels of consciousness or spiritual realms.

attributions.surface_quote: The eighth reveals the ninth.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of reality is accessible through the direct experience of divine illumination.

attributions.surface_quote: We have received the power of the eighth and the ninth.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is a self-contained, self-supporting, and invisible divine unity that generates all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: who, being self within self, supports everything, being perfect, the invisible god

canonical_statement: Human consciousness can ascend through hierarchical stages of reality, culminating in the eighth and ninth spheres.

attributions.surface_quote: take my mind to the eighth heavenly sphere and after that to the ninth

canonical_statement: The individual mind is an instrument of the divine spirit, capable of perceiving its own true nature through visionary experience.

attributions.surface_quote: I am mind, and I see another mind... I see myself.

canonical_statement: Spiritual forces exist as immortal entities that nurture and sustain individual human souls.

attributions.surface_quote: they exist as forces that nurture other souls. That is why I say they are immortal.

canonical_statement: The universe receives its soul from the divine, and all conceived things originate from the self-conceived creator.

attributions.surface_quote: From you the universe received soul. From you, one unconceived, one that has been conceived came into being.

canonical_statement: True spiritual knowledge is ineffable and transcends the capacity of language, requiring silence for its expression.

attributions.surface_quote: Speech cannot reveal this. For all of the eighth... sing a song in silence.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is the singular source and sustainer of all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: You are the light that the mind beholds.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness achieves union with the divine through the act of intellectual praise.

attributions.surface_quote: It is through your grace that we receive the knowledge of your light.

canonical_statement: The material world is a manifestation of the divine will.

attributions.surface_quote: You are the one who has established the universe.

canonical_statement: Human beings can be transformed into divine entities through the acquisition of spiritual knowledge.

attributions.surface_quote: while we were in the body, You have made us divine through Your knowledge.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an intellectual light that serves as the source and womb of all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: We have known You, intellectual light. Life of life... Womb of every creature.

canonical_statement: Human consciousness is structured to facilitate the comprehension, expression, and recognition of the Divine.

attributions.surface_quote: giving us mind, speech, and knowledge: mind to understand, speech to expound, knowledge to know.

canonical_statement: The Pleroma is a unified, infinite totality of divine emanations existing beyond temporal limitation.

attributions.surface_quote: The Pleroma is the totality of the aeons.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness originates from a process of emanation from the divine source, resulting in a state of separation.

attributions.surface_quote: The aeons emanated from the Father.

canonical_statement: The material world is a product of deficiency or ignorance arising from the limitation of divine light.

attributions.surface_quote: The world was formed from the deficiency of the aeons.

canonical_statement: Human identity is fundamentally dualistic, consisting of a material vessel and a latent divine spark.

attributions.surface_quote: The soul is trapped within the material body.

canonical_statement: Salvation is the process of gnosis, or the recollection of one's divine origin and subsequent return to the Pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: Knowledge of the Father leads to the restoration of the soul.

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of all existence is a singular, ineffable Monad existing in absolute silence and tranquility.

attributions.surface_quote: The Ineffable One who dwells in the Monad. He dwells alone in silence.

canonical_statement: The Pleroma is structured through successive emanations of pairs (syzygies) representing divine attributes.

attributions.surface_quote: He dwells in the Dyad and in the Pair, and his Pair is Silence.

canonical_statement: The material world and its inhabitants are shadows, images, and likenesses of pre-existing divine realities.

attributions.surface_quote: The creature is a shadow of pre-existing things.

canonical_statement: Human suffering and the creation of the material realm resulted from a rupture in the divine order, specifically the separation of an Aeon from her consort.

attributions.surface_quote: She dwells in herself alone without her consort. That she should suffer... was not the will.

canonical_statement: The restoration of the All occurs when the fragmented seeds of divinity are reunited with their divine counterparts within the Pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: The All will come to be in unity and reconciliation.

canonical_statement: The Demiurge functions as a secondary creator, shaping the material world using the patterns and seeds derived from the higher Pleroma.

attributions.surface_quote: The Demiurge began to create a man according to his image.
